player_prompt.intro:
D kečč imaray {player_id} ({piece}). Amsebrak d ({opp}).
Sekkelsen imarayen am '[a2 a3]' (si → ɣer).
- Imaray aberkan d asekkil aqeddim ɣer vertex tazayez tameẓyant.
- Tamḥeqt d aɣellal af anemyar aɛdaw aqeddim ɣer inudem tazayez.
Yal tamḥeqt tessuddus {score_per_capture} imḍanen.
Uraren tafukt deffir {max_moves} imarayen neɣ wakka imarayen ur ɛaqim ara.

invalid_move.dest_not_empty: Ur d-yusi ara ɣer wanda i tṛuḥ.
